turns.assessment: The persistent ~4.3 dB drop first appears at the input of amp3 on S24→S08 and remains essentially unchanged through amp3–amp6. Pump currents are stable, and amp2 input/output reportedly did not change, localizing added loss to the fibre span between amp2 and amp3 rather than an amplifier. The all-channel power reduction and resulting OSNR/BER degradation strongly indicate SPAN_LOSS_INCREASE. However, that individual span has no named element identifier in the brief, so a repair target cannot be committed safely.

proposals.rationale: O3–O10 show an approximately 4.2–4.3 dB persistent power loss beginning at amp3 input and propagating through every downstream amplifier. Amp2 monitoring showed no change and downstream pump currents remained stable, placing the loss in the span immediately upstream of amp3. Multiple channels and services are affected, matching an all-channel span loss.
